'''January 2000 Minneapolis tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Minneapolis, MN on 8 January 2000. [[Graham Neal]] won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d167">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-10-minneapolis-mn-1-8-00d167/ minneapolis-mn-1-8-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 10 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-10-minneapolis-mn-1-8-00d167/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 33
* '''Winner:''' [[Graham Neal]]
